cross_field_constraints: total_size equals the exact wire length and equals 512 + 16 * entry_count + 32
next_ingress_sequence equals processed_ingress_sequence + 1; processed_ingress_sequence is not UINT64_MAX
processed_records equals processed_ingress_sequence and is nonzero

processed_record_start_wal_pos is at least the 4096-byte Raw segment header; processed_record_end_wal_pos is greater by at least the 112-byte Raw record header-plus-trailer minimum; both processed Raw WAL cursors are 8-byte aligned
POISONED is set if and only if session_phase is POISONED, and control_decode_errors is nonzero if and only if POISONED is set
LOGGED_IN is set if and only if session_phase is LOGGED_IN; LOGGED_IN and DISCONNECTED_WINDOW cannot both be set
if LOGGED_IN is set, connection_epoch is nonzero
connection_epoch does not exceed logon_success and equals logon_success whenever POISONED is not set

INITIAL requires connection_epoch zero and DISCONNECTED_WINDOW clear; CONNECT_ERROR and DISCONNECTED require DISCONNECTED_WINDOW set; DISCONNECTED requires disconnect nonzero; LOGON_FAILED requires logon_failure nonzero

INITIAL requires current_address_sha256 and last_success_address_sha256 both zero; CONNECTING, CONNECT_ERROR, and DISCONNECTED require current_address_sha256 nonzero; DISCONNECTED_WINDOW requires current_address_sha256 nonzero; last_success_address_sha256 nonzero requires connection_epoch and current_address_sha256 nonzero; LOGGED_IN requires current_address_sha256 equal last_success_address_sha256, including the reachable all-zero pair when no API address preceded logon

the overflow-checked sum typed_event_count of logon_success, logon_failure, disconnect, subscription_responses, and control_decode_errors does not exceed emitted_control_records; untyped_event_count is emitted_control_records minus typed_event_count

CONNECTING and CONNECT_ERROR require untyped_event_count nonzero; current_address_sha256 nonzero or DISCONNECTED_WINDOW set requires the overflow-checked address-event evidence count disconnect + untyped_event_count to be nonzero
CONNECTION_SWITCHED requires connection_epoch at least two, both address hashes nonzero, and the overflow-checked address-event evidence count disconnect + untyped_event_count to be at least two
every session_phase other than INITIAL requires emitted_control_records nonzero
emitted_control_records does not exceed processed_records
each of logon_success, logon_failure, disconnect, subscription_responses, and control_decode_errors does not exceed emitted_control_records
subscription_epoch does not exceed the overflow-checked sum of logon_success and subscription_responses

checkpoint-persisted quality_flags are limited to SUBSCRIPTION_CHANGED, DECODE_TRUNCATED, DECODE_OFFSET_INVALID, NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET, SCHEMA_UNKNOWN, and UNAUTHORIZED (mask 0x0000000004096008); attribution-only and replay-provenance quality bits are forbidden

nonzero checkpoint-persisted quality_flags require emitted_control_records nonzero; at least one of DECODE_TRUNCATED, DECODE_OFFSET_INVALID, or SCHEMA_UNKNOWN is set if and only if control_decode_errors is nonzero; NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET requires emitted_control_records greater than control_decode_errors because only a successfully decoded control event can set it

SUBSCRIPTION_CHANGED requires connection_epoch and subscription_epoch nonzero and requires either at least two logon successes or at least one logon success plus one subscription response; UNAUTHORIZED requires logon_failure nonzero and LOGGED_IN clear

latest_response_ingress_sequence, latest_response_record_end_wal_pos, and response_manifest_sha256 are either all zero or all nonzero; they are nonzero if and only if at least one logon success, logon failure, or subscription response was emitted; when nonzero, latest_response_record_end_wal_pos is 8-byte aligned and the response pair either exactly equals the processed ingress/end pair or has an earlier ingress sequence with its WAL end no later than processed_record_start_wal_pos
subscription entries are in strict ascending lexicographic numeric order by (service_id, service_version, message_id), so duplicate keys are rejected
status equals zero whenever status_known equals zero; connection_epoch zero requires status_known zero for every entry
required_mask has bit i set exactly when subscription entry i has REQUIRED policy
effective_mask has bit i set exactly when subscription entry i has status_known equal to 1 and status equal to zero
effective_success_mask equals effective_mask
required_first_seen_mask is a subset of both required_mask and effective_mask
if connection_epoch equals zero, effective_mask and subscription_epoch both equal zero; a nonzero effective_mask requires a nonzero subscription_epoch
CONTROL_READY equals (!POISONED && LOGGED_IN && session_phase == LOGGED_IN && ((effective_mask & required_mask) == required_mask))
DECODER_EVIDENCE_READY equals (CONTROL_READY && ((required_first_seen_mask & required_mask) == required_mask))
decoder_checks: wire length is at least 544 before fixed fields are read
magic, version, header_size, and entry_size equal their fixed values
entry_count is in [1, 64] and wire length exactly matches total_size
all header and entry reserved bytes are zero
header_crc32c matches CRC-32C over exactly the 512-byte header with the CRC field zeroed
checkpoint_sha256 matches SHA-256 over bytes [0, total_size - 32), including the stored header_crc32c and all entries
all field and cross-field constraints pass
encoder_behavior: the entire output buffer is initialized to zero before fields and entries are stored
header_crc32c is computed and stored before checkpoint_sha256 is computed
stable_config_sha256, requested_manifest_sha256, response_manifest_sha256, current_address_sha256, last_success_address_sha256, and state_sha256 are model values; this codec does not recompute them
